orquesta: ROYAT was born in Tizimín in 2018.
Our first vaquería was at the Sucilá Fair.
We are sixteen musicians in five sections.
Arturo Turriza conducts… and plays the baritone sax.
In 2026 we reached the Palacio de la Música.
We have ten releases on Spotify.
Three voices sing every jarana: Erik, Gabriel and Josué.
jarana: The jarana is danced in 6×8 and in 3×4.
At the vaquería someone shouts ¡Bomba! and throws out a verse.
The terno is the mestiza's gala dress.
mapa: It all started in Tizimín, in 2018.
Don't see your town? Click it and invite us.
We also play in Quintana Roo and Campeche.
contacto: Follow us on social media and don't miss a single vaquería.
All the records are on Spotify and Apple Music.
The videos are on TikTok and YouTube.
discos: «La Fiesta de Yucatán» has twenty pieces.
«¡A Bailar en Tizimín!» was recorded live at the Tizimín Vaquería 2024.
«Jubileo de Oro» features Manuel Castillo, Irbin Castillo and Joss Novelo.
Scroll and I'll show you the records. Click one and it plays.
